cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: More Official Than You
cards.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your picnic rota is useful. Mine has committee approval.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine got everyone to bring sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Mine establishes who was entitled to request those sandwiches.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then approve mine. We've already started eating.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll attach it as an appendix to mine, so lunch has a legitimate basis.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.text: Your bow at the ceremony was adequate. Mine follows the founder's original diagram.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The founder asked us to wave instead.

beats.text: His original diagram is in the constitution. My bow follows that.

cards.title: A Valuable Safeguard
cards.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll lose the season.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the safest season we've ever offered.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A

cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Yes, I'll clean the hall. The policy lets senior volunteers supervise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm asking you to mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Exactly. Supervising the mop is covered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who will hold it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone whose contribution isn't restricted by seniority.
